portal.vendor_source: portal fingerprint: bespoke 'casetrackerplanning' ASP.NET WebForms register (__VIEWSTATE, ApplicationSearch.aspx and ApplicationDetails.aspx) with documents on a classic-ASP 'Case Tracker' (casetracker.asp); none of the vendors.json signatures matched

document_host.note: The register's detail page lists no documents. The document list is the council's Case Tracker: ocella_crossreference.asp?type=planning&ref=<REF> redirects (302) to casetracker.asp?public=Y&caseid=<n>, which lists casetracker_download.asp?case=<n>&GUID=<guid> links. Each of those returns an HTML interstitial that stages the file and links to it under /downloadfiles/; the file itself is that link. Despite the 'ocella' in the redirector's name, no Ocella endpoints are involved.

committee_papers.note: Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-26. The same system lists a current 'Planning Inquiry' (363) and the 'Executive Portfolio for Planning and Development' (267). No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: P/YY/NNNN/TYPE; some types carry a further segment, e.g. P/25/1272/DP/G.

quirks.summary: casetracker_download.asp returns a ~12 KB HTML page (200, text/html), not the file; the page stages a PDF copy and links to it under /downloadfiles/.
quirks.detail: Saving the casetracker_download.asp response as the document gives an HTML file with a .pdf name.
quirks.workaround: Parse the /downloadfiles/<name>.pdf link from the interstitial and GET it; check %PDF- on that.

quirks.summary: Previously recorded as DEF Atrium (and before that as Ocella); the register is a bespoke casetrackerplanning WebForms app, and Recipe A does not apply.
quirks.detail: The 2026-09-16 survey fingerprinted the council's main website root, not the register.
quirks.workaround: Use the Case Tracker route in portal.document_host.

endpoints.note: Detail page: ApplicationDetails.aspx?reference=<REF>&uprn=<uprn> (PlanIt's url). Documents need only the reference, via the redirector.

browser_route.note: URL-encode the reference. Opens the Case Tracker page with the document list.

pacing.note: About ten requests at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26, no 429 or challenge.

robots.note: www.fareham.gov.uk/robots.txt disallows /casetracker/casetracker.asp (the document list page) and /pdf/, among other site paths. /casetrackerplanning/, the redirector and /downloadfiles/ are not listed.
